rules.expected: Inspect species_registry, every input/geometry mapping and real raw log. Verify stoichiometry, charge/multiplicity, method/state, stationarity or constrained label, and consistent thermochemistry. Use full ODA, 6FODA, PFMB and TMC mapped graphs. The selected TMC site is acyl C2/Cl3; shift TMC maps by +1000 to avoid molecule-map collisions. For each amine, attack with the lowest-numbered supplied amine N and retain the second NH2 unchanged. Model the same net reaction TMC+diamine→monoamide+HCl, with departing chloride as the proton acceptor and no arbitrary free proton. This first-version local gas-phase model at 298.15 K/1 M is benchmark-authored and does not model the membrane interface. Retain source-comparable isolated gas-phase electronic descriptors on their defined scale as auxiliary tests. No polymer MD or membrane performance is required.

scoring_notes: Schema/transport validation does not establish scientific correctness or calibrated scoring.
No new target tolerance is frozen; calibrate using complete paths, conformer/method sensitivity and source measurement uncertainty.
Supporting, contradictory and fully evidenced indistinguishable results receive equal endpoint credit.
Uncomputed core controls receive no endpoint credit; bounded failure cannot acquire a completion PASS.
